title: 2027 AfOx Kennedy DPhil studentships
institution: The Kennedy Institute of Rheumatology, University of Oxford
about: Fully funded 4-year DPhil studentships in Molecular and Cellular Medicine at the Kennedy Institute of Rheumatology, University of Oxford, for students from Africa, in partnership with the Africa Oxford Initiative. Complete applications are due by noon on 1 December 2026.
requirements: For students from Africa (joint partnership with the Africa Oxford Initiative)
Applicants must contact the supervisor of any project before applying
Application is complete only when all sections, transcript and personal statement are submitted, at least 2 of 3 referees have submitted references and the fee is paid
AfOx applicants must select Reuben College
